spans.s: 1. दोष m. evening, darkness (only BhP., where personified as one of the 8 Vasus and husband of Night, vi, 6, 11; 14)
2. दोष m. rarely n. (√ दुष्) fault, vice, deficiency, want, inconvenience, disadvantage, Up.; Mn.; MBh.; Kāv. &c.
badness, wickedness, sinfulness, Mn.; R.
offence, transgression, guilt, crime (acc. with √ ऋ or लभ्, to incur guilt), ŚrS.; Mn.; MBh. &c.
damage, harm, bad consequence, detrimental effect (नैष दोषः, there is no harm; कोऽत्र द्˚, what does it matter?), Mn.; MBh.; Kāv. &c.
accusation, reproach (˚षं√ कृ or ˚षेण-√ गम् with acc., to accuse), R.
alteration, affection, morbid element, disease (esp. of the 3 humours of the body, viz. पित्त, वायु, and श्लेष्मन्, [cf. त्रिदोष and धातु], applied also to the humours themselves), Suśr.
(also ˚षक) a calf, L.
See next.
1. दोषा॑ f. darkness, night, RV.; AV. &c. (˚षा॑म् ind. & ˚षा॑ [instr.; cf. g. स्वर्-आदि] ind. in the evening, at dusk, at night)

Night personified (and regarded with, Prabh. as wife of Puṣpārṇa and mother of Pradoṣa or Evening, Niśitha [!] or Midnight and Vyuṣṭa or Day-break), BhP. iv, 13, 13; 14 (cf. दोष॑स्, पश्चा-दोष, प्र-दोष, प्रति-दोषम्)
ind., [instr.; cf. g. स्वर्-आदि] in the evening, at dusk, at night
2. दोषा f. (for 1. See 1. दोष) the arm, L.
ind., in the evening, at dusk, at night
1. दोषा—कर m. ‘night-maker’, the moon, Satr.
2. दोषाकर m. a mine or heap of faults, Kathās.
दोष—कर mf(ई)n. causing evil or harm, pernicious, Var.
दोषा—क्लेशी f. ‘fading in the evening’, a kind of plant, L.
दोषा—तन mf(ई)n. (fr. दोषा ind.) nocturnal, at evening, Ragh. xiii, 76.
दोषा—तिलक m. ‘night-ornament’, a lamp, L.
दोषा—भूत mfn. (fr. दोषा ind.) having become n˚, turned into n˚ (day), Uṇ. iv, 174, Sch.
दोषा—मन्य mfn. (fr. दोषा ind.) considered as n˚, passing for n˚ (day), Śiś. iv, 62
cf. Pāṇ. vi, 3, 66, Kāś.
दोषा—रमण m. ‘N˚'s lover’, the moon, Dhūrtan. ii, 22.
दोषा—वस्तृ m. illuminer of the dark (Agni), RV.
‘face of the night’, a lamp, L.
evening, dusk, AV. xvi, 4, 6.

दोष—कारिन् and दोष—कृत्, mfn. id., ib.
दोष—कल्पन n. attributing blame, reprehending, W.
दोष—गुण n. bad and good qualities, Mn. ix, 330
दोष—गु˚णी-करण n. turning a fault into a merit, Kuval., Sch.
दोष—गुणिन् mfn. having good and bad qualities
दोष—गु˚णि-त्व n., Mn. viii, 338, Sch.
दोष—ग्रस्त mfn. involved in guilt, guilty, MW.
दोष—ग्राहिन् mfn. fault-finding, censorious, susceptible of evil, L. (cf. गुण-).
दोष—घ्न mf(ई)n. removing the bad humours, Suśr.
दोष—जित्-कार m. N. of wk.

knowing what is evil or to be avoided, prudent, wise, Ragh. i, 93
दोष—ज्ञ m. a physician, L.
a Pandit, teacher, discerning man, W.
दोष—तस् ind. from a fault or defect
दोष—˚तो-√ ब्रू to accuse of a fault, R. ii, 61, 34.
दोष—त्रय n. vitiation of the 3 humours (above)
any combination of 3 defects, W.

दोष—त्रय—हर mfn. removing the 3 bad h˚, Suśr.
दोष—त्व n. faultiness, deficiency, Sāh.
दोष—दूषित mfn. disfigured by a fault
दोष—दूषित—त्व n., Sarvad.
दोष—दृष्टि f. looking at faults, f˚-finding, MW.
दोष—द्वय n. a combination of two evils, Pracaṇḍ. i, 68.
दोष—निर्घात m. expiation of a crime, penance, Āpast.
दोष—परिहार m. N. of wk.
दोष—प्रसङ्ग m. attaching blame, condemnation, W.
दोष—फल n. the fruit or consequence of a sin, Āp.
दोष—फल mfn. sinful, wicked, ib.
दोष—बल-प्रवृत्त mfn. proceeding from the influence of bad humours (a disease), Suśr.
दोष—भक्ति f. tendency to a disease, Car.
दोष—भाज् mfn. possessing faults or doing wrong, Yājñ.

दोष—भीति f. fear of offence, MW.

दोष—भे˚दीय mfn. relating to it, Cat.

connected with crime or guilt, sinful, wicked, Gaut.; Āp.; Mn.
noxious, dangerous, R.

perceiving faults, MBh. i, 3068.
talking over faults, tale-bearing, MW.

incurring a f˚, MW.

water caused by dropsy, ib.

N. of wk.

(occurring only in nom. du. दोष॑णी, AV.; AitBr.; gen. sg. दोष्ण॑स्, ŚBr.; instr. दोष्णा loc. दोष्णि [or दोषणि- See below] gen. du. दोष्णोस्, Rājat.; acc. pl. [m. !] दोष्णस्, Pāṇ. vi, 1, 63; the other forms are supplied by दोस्, q.v.) the forearm, the lower part of the forefoot of an animal
the arm in general.
leaning or hanging on the arm, AV. vi, 9, 2.
दोषण्य᳙ mfn. being in or belonging to the arm, RV.; AV.
(m. only, R. vi, 1, 3; nom. acc. sg. दो॑स्, ŚBr.; du. दोषी, Kauś.; दोर्भ्याम् n., MBh.; Kāv.; pl. ˚भिस्, Mālav.; दोःषु, BhP.) the forearm, the arm &c. = दोषन् (q.v.)
the part of an arc defining its sine, Sūryas.
the side of a triangle or square, W. (cf. बाहु and भुज).
having arms, HPariś.
placed on the arm, W.
servant (cf. पार्श्व-स्थ), service, L.
player, play, L.
